title: Bring the research station back online
description: A storm has isolated a research station. Restore useful equipment by constructing, measuring, predicting and diagnosing its real circuit states. More than one investigation order; experiments expose conservation.
audience: Learners approaching A-level physics, with optional GCSE bridges; curious adult explorers welcome
level: Introduction bridging GCSE to A-level DC circuits

skills.title: Explain closed-path charge flow and distinguish current from charge
skills.criterion: Correct mechanism prediction and applicable numeric/design task with correct units; at least two fresh independent opportunities, not completion count

scopeNote: Partial first-episode prototype: 1 of 10 planned episodes. Ten short investigations of ideal DC resistors, source and switches, conservation, measurement, power, open faults and repair; optional unrestricted exploration within the bounded model
